scripts.test:a11y: npm run build:standalone && npm run test:a11y:run
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:standalone && npm run test:e2e:run
scripts.test:e2e:run: HELPARR_E2E_TEST=1 vitest run test/queue-removal.test.ts test/queue-perf.test.ts test/queue-interaction.test.ts test/search-grab.test.ts test/search-interaction.test.ts test/search-perf.test.ts test/saved-search-interaction.test.ts test/first-run.test.ts test/reduced-motion.test.ts test/text-resize.test.ts test/zoom-clipping.test.ts test/bare-metal-bind.test.ts test/gaps-interaction.test.ts test/gaps-perf.test.ts test/rename-interaction.test.ts test/rename-perf.test.ts
scripts.build:standalone: next build && cp -R .next/static .next/standalone/.next/static && mkdir -p .next/standalone/public && cp -R public/. .next/standalone/public/ && cp start.mjs .next/standalone/start.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build:standalone && npm run build:image
scripts.build:screenshots: npm run build:standalone && HELPARR_SHOTS=1 vitest run test/screenshots.test.ts
